# Finding ∫ 3x³ sin(2x) dx

I'll use **tabular integration by parts** (repeated integration by parts):

## Setting Up the Table

| Sign | Derivatives of 3x³ | Integrals of sin(2x) |
|------|-------------------|---------------------|
| +    | 3x³              | -cos(2x)/2         |
| -    | 9x²              | -sin(2x)/4         |
| +    | 18x              | cos(2x)/8          |
| -    | 18               | sin(2x)/16         |

## Combining Terms

$$\int 3x^3 \sin(2x)\,dx = 3x^3\left(-\frac{\cos(2x)}{2}\right) - 9x^2\left(-\frac{\sin(2x)}{4}\right) + 18x\left(\frac{\cos(2x)}{8}\right) - 18\left(\frac{\sin(2x)}{16}\right) + C$$

## Simplifying

$$= -\frac{3}{2}x^3\cos(2x) + \frac{9}{4}x^2\sin(2x) + \frac{9}{4}x\cos(2x) - \frac{9}{8}\sin(2x) + C$$

## Verification (by differentiating)

- d/dx[-3/2 · x³ · cos(2x)] = -9/2 · x² · cos(2x) + 3x³ · sin(2x)
- d/dx[9/4 · x² · sin(2x)] = 9/2 · x · sin(2x) + 9/2 · x² · cos(2x)
- d/dx[9/4 · x · cos(2x)] = 9/4 · cos(2x) - 9/2 · x · sin(2x)
- d/dx[-9/8 · sin(2x)] = -9/4 · cos(2x)

All terms cancel except **3x³ · sin(2x)** ✓

<answer>-3/2*x**3*cos(2*x) + 9/4*x**2*sin(2*x) + 9/4*x*cos(2*x) - 9/8*sin(2*x) + C</answer>
